title: MarxBase: gene-phenotype results for Kluyveromyces marxianus metabolic engineering
description:
MarxBase is a searchable, citable collection of gene-phenotype results for Kluyveromyces marxianus metabolic engineering. Each result was extracted from a published paper's abstract and checked by a person. This archive holds the website code and the released data bundle (CSV, SQLite, CSL-JSON, data dictionary, checksums). Website: https://marxbase.org

Data are released under CC BY 4.0; the website code is MIT licensed. Release 1.0 does not include quoted evidence sentences.
